name: fl-star-crossnode
description: The radio star spread ACROSS MACHINES: the server binds its ports inside its pod, and publishes them on its node's IP with expose-my-port.sh, so a client on another machine can reach them.

advertise.note: made by: expose-my-port.sh 5599 35999 ; expose-my-port.sh 5700 35700 — pin the nodePorts so this file stays true across sessions. The host is the NODE's IP, and it changes per session: pass --net-host/--ack-host at launch when it does.

nodes.note: TWO listeners, so two published ports: 5599 is the ARQ acknowledgement the RF receiver accepts, 5700 is the TCP reply it serves
a transmitter binds NOTHING — it dials the sink, so it needs no published port of its own
